notes.title: Room building/editing update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It has been a while, but a new update has arrived! 
A rewrite of the building system has been done. While most work is invisible for you as a player, it allows for better bug fixing! It also allowed us to add a new feature: edit and move complete classrooms!
This should make building your favorite school even easier.

If you have any suggestions or ideas, don't hesitate to send a message!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MmxWB68Iv9A

Read the  full change log below:
- Rewrite of the building system to improve performance
- Add 3D icons to build walls
- Add possibility to move a room, including all the objects inside
- Add check if name of the school is not empty
- Fix bug where walls that are being edited are not rendered correctly on two sides
- Fix bug where plints are being rendered in green, while they do not even exist
- Fix bug where the first student would have an empty name
- Fix rare silent error when creating new games from the main menu
- Update SteamWorks
- Fix text not displaying while choosing where to spawn new students
- Add more student comments
- Add more teacher comments
- Add proper mouse movement support for windowed games
- Fix tutorial text to make it clearer what has to be done
- Fix bug where the floor was removed from a classroom, even though we were not allowed to remove the classroom and we cancelled
- Add info message when trying to build a door when no rooms are available
- Add info message when building a wallpaper and no rooms are available
- Fix highlighting particles when an object is clickable
- Fix buttons of radio objects
- Fix bug that would allow the user to move the boss desk, even when used
- Fix bug where costs did not show up when editing a wall for the first time
- Allow vending machines to be placed outside
- Reduce the maximum amount of soccer fields to 1, since more soccer fields do not have any positive nor negative effect
- Fix bug where bins could not be removed or moved
- Fix bug where materials of the street are not being rendered properly
- Fix crash if the headmaster could not get to the bossdesk, but was still sent home

Thank you! Enjoy playing.
Sincerely,
WeersProductions

notes.title: Camera update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you for all your feedback and enthusiasm!

If you have any feedback, don't hesitate to send a message!

notes.title: Bug and performance update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am proud to announce another update of Rule Your School. It has been a while, but [b]a lot[/b] of bugs have been fixed. The performance is also way better than before! 

The game loads in the background of the main menu, path-finding is not as buggy and menu performance has increased!

The overall stability of the game should be way better now. 
I'd like to thank everyone that supported the game and (while it has been a long time) I hope you like the update.


Full change-log:
-	Object outlines update properly while building
-	Buttons of Speech-bubbles work properly again
-	Unity upgraded
-	Diaries work properly again
-	Fix bug where doors are not visually deleted (only internally)
-	Fix loading accuracy
-	Fix deleting objects and saving
-	Fix typo in School Swimming news message
-	Fix bug where floors are not removed in a room
-	Fix walls not being removed when they are for two sides (two rooms next to each other)
-	Fix saving of floors of rooms that have been removed
-	If you don’t have money, floors are set to grass instead of the last material
-	Fix input that was blocked after closing the Graphs menu
-	Block the keyboard button ‘R’ (to rotate an object) if it’s not allowed
-	Fix building grid removal if building objects like flowers (where you can drag to ‘paint’ objects)
-	Grid shows on mouse hover when building objects like flowers (where you can drag to ‘paint’ objects)
-	Reduce glitching of students and teachers when changing object placements while they’re walking
-	Lower height of soccerfield
-	Check input of the bank menu to make sure it’s a valid number
-	Improve quality of explosion particles of chemistry tables
-	Improve performance of students’ and teachers’ animations 
-	Improve main menu environment
-	Improve loading screen of main menu
-	Improve input performance 
-	Move speed is now dependent of level of zooming (now it’s way easier to move around in your school!)
-	Improve performance of ‘hire teacher’ menu
-	Improve main menu performance
-	Increase render performance of grid
-	Load main scene async while in Main Menu to reduce loading times
-	Fix refresh of map list after deleting a map (in Main Menu)
-	Now you will only place floors where you can see them
-	Fix changing views
-	Students will no longer select their own table to talk to (they’re not that lonely anymore)
-	Particles are no longer outlined during building
-	Improve performance of floor building
-	While building floors, no other objects can be accidentally edited anymore
-	UI now blocks input when building (no longer worry about placing floors everywhere just because you clicked a button!)
-	Improved bank menu using icons instead of text

Thank you for playing and have a nice day :)

Sincerely,
Floris Weers

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It took us quite some time, but here we are with another update! This time we did not only fix a lot of bugs, we also added new features.
A complete Relation system is added to the game! This means students are not just lifeless creatures, but they now like (or hate) other students, or teachers.

[img=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3972/3971947/profileupdate/RelationsMenu.png]

[img=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3972/3971947/profileupdate/RelationsMenu2.png]

[img=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3972/3971947/profileupdate/RelationsMenu3.png]


You can read their diary when clicking on a student and then pressing the 'diary' menu item. This new system brings a lot more life to your school.

[img=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3972/3971947/profileupdate/Relations.jpg]

[img=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3972/3971947/profileupdate/Relations2.jpg]

We also got various feedback about the 'view' system. If you did not know already, at the top of the screen a dropdown button was added in the last update. 
It allows you to select what you want to see in your school. The default view does not contain anything special, but the 'wifi' view makes sure you can see the range of your routers!
This can be really nice if you are building that new classroom which (obviously) needs super fast internet!
Since it can be a bit hard sometimes to see what tables are unreachable, we added a new view. This view will show unreachable tables in your school!

Another thing we worked on is the design of menus. We remade the 'options' menu and the school paper. Now you can enjoy the schoolpaper even more!

[img=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3972/3971947/profileupdate/OptionMenu.png]

Of course besides these new features, we also fixed bugs and improved the performance of the game. Pathfinding is now a lot faster, which means you will see less students/teachers thinking about how to walk ;).

[list]
[*]A new relation system
[*]At least 10 times faster loading of maps
[*]A new view that shows tables that are unreachable
[*]You can now set the starting position of the teachers and students
[*]Easier to edit buildings that are already built, just click and hold your mouse button!
[*]Added two new floors
[*]Redesign of the options and newspaper screens
[*]Improvement of the overall performance
[*]A lot of bug fixes!
[/list]
If you find any bugs, don't hesitate to contact us! If you have any other suggestions, we would love to hear those as well of course.

Sincerely,
WeersProductions

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce another small update. It contains various bug fixes:

[list]
[*]You can now edit objects while building! This means that you no longer have to close the building menu to simply edit an object. Just click and hold on an object to start editing it! (To edit walls,  you still have to exit the building menu.)
[*]You can now zoom out a bit more!
[*]Players without a middle mouse button can now zoom as well, using '+' and '-' or 'm' and 'n'.
[*]Fixed a bug where removing the soccerfield was impossible.
[*]Changed various hitboxes of objects to be more accurate.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy it :)

notes.title: Views and more!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We would like to thank everyone for supporting us. We're  a very small team, but we really love Rule Your School. A new update has been published, which contains new objects!

[list]
    [*]Wifi! We cannot live without it, and your students want it too! Build Routers and make sure all rooms have good wifi. A room without wifi means students who will complain.
[*]Views! To make sure it's easy to see the range of your Routers, we've added views. You can switch views on the top of your screen, or by pressing 'V'. Currently the game has two views, normal view and wifi view. 
[*]Smoother building. To make our building system even smoother, we've changed some mechanics while building. You do not have to press the confirm button everytime you're done building, simply start building something else!
[*]Easier editing. You could already edit objects by clicking and holding your mouse button on an object you had build. To make it easier to edit whole classrooms, you can now simply start editing any object and it will finish the last one!
[*]Easier tutorial. We've made the tutorial easier to do. Every button you have to press will be highlighted. Now you no longer have to search for hours ;).
[*]Shortcuts. Use 'enter' to confirm a building, 'r' to rotate a building, 'v' to switch views and 'space' to switch time!
[*]Keybindings. You can assign different keys to all shortcuts above in the Unity start-up screen. (at the 'input' tab).
[*]Fixed all known bugs.
[/list] 

Thank you for your feedback! If you have any problems, don't hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,
WeersProductions

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for all the support and feedback. We've published a little update:

[list]
    [*]Support for users without a middle mouse button. Use Left-ctrl in combination with the right mouse button to rotate the camera.
    [*]Fixed a bug where the wrong image is shown in a random event.
    [*]Fixed a bug where it was hard to buy an upgrade in the upgrade screen. You can now click the tooltip to buy the upgrade!
[*]Changed the layout of the "create new school" menu.
[*]Fixed 32 bit.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the game, if you find any problems, don't hesitate to contact us!

Sincerely,
WeersProductions
